## Before you update

- Back up first (the installer does it for you; [docs/RECOVERY.md](https://github.com/pssdrnk-cmyk/DUELL-TIDE/blob/stable/docs/RECOVERY.md) has the way back).
- Anything that changes on its own after the update, for example a setting that resets. Say "nothing" if nothing does.

## Install

Open the installer: <https://pssdrnk-cmyk.github.io/DUELL-TIDE/install/> (Chrome or Edge, data USB cable straight into the computer), or build it yourself ([docs/BUILDS.md](https://github.com/pssdrnk-cmyk/DUELL-TIDE/blob/jam11/docs/BUILDS.md)). Checksum: `<sha256 of the .fwsc>`.

Everything this build holds: [CHANGELOG-TIDE](https://github.com/pssdrnk-cmyk/DUELL-TIDE/blob/jam11/CHANGELOG-TIDE.md#<anchor>).
